scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -k -n public,workspace,scout "npm run dev:public" "npm run dev:workspace" "npm run dev:scout"
scripts.prebuild: npm run prebuild:content && npm run prebuild:corpus
scripts.prebuild:corpus: node scripts/build-public-corpus.js && node scripts/build-guide-context.js && node scripts/build-kjv-context.js && node scripts/build-proverbs-json.js
scripts.build: npm run build:scout && npm run build:public && npm run build:workspace
scripts.build:netlify: npm run prebuild:content && npm run build:public && node scripts/generate-asset-manifest.js
scripts.build:scout:forge: npm run prebuild && SCOUT_WEB_ADAPTER=node npm run build -w @hoggcountry/scout-web && npm --prefix mobile run build
scripts.build:game: cd trailhogg/trailhogg && npm install && cd shared && npm install && npm run build && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --experimental-transform-types --test scripts/parse-master-guide.test.js scripts/kjv-pce.test.mjs scripts/weather-assessor.test.mjs scripts/scout-skills.test.mjs scripts/eval-scout-sources.mjs scripts/scout-reliability-arena.test.mjs scripts/scout-reliability-graders.test.mjs scripts/scout-runtime-tools.test.mjs scripts/scout-web-research.test.mjs scripts/scout-web-model-provider.test.mjs scripts/trail-assistant-forge-intake-contract.test.mjs scripts/scout-mobile-recovery.test.mjs scripts/scout-concierge-runtime.test.mjs scripts/scout-beta-logins.test.mjs scripts/scout-beta-cookie.test.mjs scripts/scout-chatgpt-login.test.mjs scripts/scout-production-runtime.test.mjs scripts/scout-loadout.test.mjs scripts/scout-documents.test.mjs scripts/scout-today-context.test.mjs scripts/scout-waitlist.test.mjs scripts/at-mile-calibration.test.mjs scripts/scout-journey.test.mjs scripts/scout-day-replay.test.mjs scripts/scout-grounding-consistency.test.mjs scripts/scout-mobile-contract.test.mjs scripts/mobile-privacy-contract.test.mjs scripts/mobile-trail-pulse-contract.test.mjs scripts/mobile-accessibility-contract.test.mjs scripts/mobile-release-proof-contract.test.mjs scripts/scout-public-mobile-field-pack.test.mjs scripts/scout-trail-conditions.test.mjs scripts/scout-park-facilities.test.mjs scripts/scout-awol-water.test.mjs scripts/scout-mobile-runtime.test.mjs scripts/scout-mobile-offline-refresh.test.mjs scripts/scout-local-ai-eval-suite.test.mjs data/at-open-reference/tests/at-open-reference.test.mjs
scripts.awol:build-water: npm run awol:pdf-to-text && npm run awol:extract-water && npm run import:awol-water && npm run ref:awol-water
scripts.backend:install: sh -c 'cd backend && composer install && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && (grep -q "^APP_KEY=base64:" .env || php artisan key:generate) && php artisan migrate'
scripts.monorepo:dev: npx concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev" "npm run backend:dev"
scripts.monorepo:check: npm run build && npm run backend:frontend:build && npm run backend:test
scripts.start:scout:forge: cd apps/openclaw-web && HOST=${HOST:-127.0.0.1} PORT=${PORT:-3000} node build
scripts.forge:scout:pm2: pm2 startOrReload apps/openclaw-web/ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env && npm run forge:scout-chatgpt-app:pm2:optional
scripts.forge:scout-chatgpt-app:pm2:optional: if [ -f apps/scout-chatgpt-app/build/server.js ]; then pm2 startOrReload apps/scout-chatgpt-app/ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env; else echo "Skipping Scout ChatGPT app PM2 reload; built server is not present in this release."; fi
